REPLACE:spread_philhellenism = {
	ability = dip
	allow_multiple = no
	
	potential = {
		tag = BYZ

		has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			court_language = language:greek_language
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		cultural_influence_modifier = 0.1
		research_speed_modifier = 0.05
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = { 
				limit = { at_war = yes }
				subtract = {
					value = 100
					desc = AT_WAR
				}
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = { num_loans > 0 }
				add = {
					value = num_loans
					multiply = -5
					desc = "loans"
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = stability
				desc = "current stability"
			}
			add = {
				value = government_power
				subtract = 50
				desc = "current gov power"
			}
		}
	}
}
